main_text.p: Calamus odoratus, Calamus mensorius, Scapus slatera: plur. קָנִים & קָנוֹת.
קָנְיָן m. Possessio, Acquisitio, Negotiatio: plur. קִנְיָנִים.
מִקְנָה m. Pecus, Possessio: plur. מִקְנִים.
קִן Pihel Nidificare. Pyhal קֻנַּן Nidificari facta est.
קִנְצִים קִנָּץ m.p. Fines: Vide & קָצַץ.
קַעֲרָה f. Scutula, Scutella: plur. קְעָרוֹת.
קָפָא Concrescere, Coagulari. Hiphil הִקְפִּיא Coagulare.
קָפוֹד m. Anataria, aquila species: alii aliter explicant, nunc Erisium, nunc Noctuam.
קִפּוֹז קִפּוֹ m. Merula. Quidam volunt idem esse quod קִפּוֹז.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-style vocalisation is reproduced approximately; the running head line and the dagger-like marks at the top are partly blurred. The Hebrew entries are transcribed from the printed letters as far as legible; some vowel points are uncertain and not marked individually.
